data.text: Friction: task claim does not show the task's acceptance criteria, in text or in --json, so an agent that claims and starts never sees the definition of done unless it also runs task show. Measured on this journal 2026-10-12: 80 of 81 tasks carry criteria, 10 of 67 done tasks closed with some unchecked, and nearly all of those are board DoD items that never applied (npm test green on Probe B interview tasks KAD-1/2/4, on releases, on the site task KAD-73). The checklist is turning into noise people learn to skip.
